name: Tax Identification Number (TIN)
note: Belize's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: individuals are not issued a TIN automatically; they usually apply on taking employment, and one isn't mandatory for someone neither employed nor in business; seven digits, six generated by the Revenue Management System and a check digit (rule not given, `check` left out). The sheet's header names the Belize Tax Service. Read as given on starting work, to workers. No age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Belize: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: Belize Tax Service ... Individuals usually applies for TIN upon employment. If and individual is not employed nor an owner, shareholder, or director to a business entity, it is not mandatory to have a Tax Identification Number. ... The TIN consists of 7 digits which includes the use of check digit.
